legal_basis.current_status: Current applicability and later local restrictions not independently verified

notes: The 2012 Gazette identifies A04 km 420.00–422.50 as built-up; matching its chainage to map geometry requires authoritative reference points.
Other roads are not automatically assigned the 50 km/h built-up limit merely because they are within Kattankudy town.
For unclassified road segments the 70 km/h non-built-up legal default is only a candidate, not a verified posted limit. Never show it as verified navigation guidance.
Check later amendments, signs, school zones, temporary restrictions and applicable local regulations before public speed guidance.
